title: Digital Marketing Specialist
description_raw: CloudWave is hiring a Digital Marketing Specialist with 1-3 years experience in paid search, LinkedIn ads, web analytics, and funnel optimization. You will manage campaigns to generate high-intent B2B demo requests, optimize landing page conversion rates using Hotjar and Unbounce, and deliver daily reports in Looker Studio.
responsibilities: Run targeted search and paid social campaigns for B2B demo acquisition.
Monitor user behavior using Hotjar and optimize landing pages to increase lead conversions.
Analyze weekly funnel drop-offs and optimize ad copy messaging.
